なぜ牛乳ブランドが女子サッカーを育てるのか――MilkLife's sports ecosystem in Indonesia

Why would a dairy brand build girls' football competitions? MilkLife started a local tournament in 2023 and plans to reach 15 cities in the 2026–27 season. 日本の元代表選手とポケモンのイベントから出発し、学校・指導者・継続大会をつなぐ仕組みを現地報道で追う。The essay separates documented growth from unproven commercial effects and explores the ethical questions around youth sponsorship.
